# Run from the repository directory. No API key is needed for dry runs.
go run . -query "artificial intelligence" -days 2 -limit 5 -dry-run
go run . -query "space exploration" -days 7 -limit 10 -dry-run

# Invalid input: expect a nonzero exit status.
go run . -query "space exploration" -days 0 -limit 5 -dry-run

# Live search: set NEWS_API_KEY locally first.
go run . -query "artificial intelligence" -days 2 -limit 5
